subject: general
question: Why is an electrodynamometer-type power factor meter preferred in AC circuits?

options.text: It does not require voltage connections.
It can measure both single-phase and three-phase power factors
It can measure DC power factor accurately.
It has a faster response time.

solution:
In AC power systems, the electrodynamometer-type power factor meter is highly valued for its versatility and design.

__**Explanation:**__

The primary advantage of the electrodynamometer-type power factor meter is its adaptability to different circuit configurations.

 
• 
 
**Versatility:** This type of meter **can measure both single-phase and three-phase power factors** effectively.

 
 
• 
 
**No Control Springs:** Unlike standard meters, it does not use control springs. The moving system is governed entirely by the ratio of the magnetic forces in the two coils, which means the pointer remains at its last position when the meter is disconnected.

 
 
• 
 
**Accuracy:** It provides high accuracy in AC circuits as it is inherently sensitive to the phase displacement between the voltage and current.
